sessions.phase_label: Backend, frontend, authentication, payments, and gamification integration
Launch content, ebook access, payment planning, and production deployment
Production minting, rewards, dashboard, and reader stabilization

requirements.title: Project Rebuild Branding
requirements.definition: Use Project Rebuild as the current project name while reserving BooksOnChain as a possible future platform identity.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the current product identity only; future DAO and BooksOnChain functionality is not inferred from the naming vision.

requirements.title: Mauritius Landing-Page Geoblock
requirements.definition: Prevent users in Mauritius from accessing the Project Rebuild landing page.
requirements.boundary_note: The geoblock is an access-control behavior independent of payment-provider availability for a Mauritius-incorporated business.

requirements.title: Wallet Authentication
requirements.definition: Support wallet-based authentication using Sign-In with Ethereum for crypto user paths.
requirements.boundary_note: Wallet authentication is independently usable and testable from email authentication and public unauthenticated access.

requirements.title: Email Magic-Link Authentication
requirements.definition: Support low-friction email authentication, such as magic links, for dashboard access by users without a conventional wallet workflow.
requirements.boundary_note: This covers user authentication, not delivery reliability for transactional emails.

requirements.title: Unauthenticated Public API Access
requirements.definition: Expose public information such as leaderboards and prize-pool values without requiring authentication.
requirements.boundary_note: Public API access can remain available while wallet or email authentication changes independently.

requirements.title: Transactional Email Delivery
requirements.definition: Send authentication, confirmation, reward, and notification emails reliably through the configured email service.
requirements.boundary_note: Brevo is an attribute/provider choice for this behavior; individual tests of delivery are execution evidence rather than a separate testing Requirement.

requirements.title: Small Block Prize Mechanism
requirements.definition: Run the recurring small-block prize mechanism with the client-defined pool, winner count, prize amount, and sales trigger.
requirements.boundary_note: Winner count, prize amount, and trigger frequency are attributes of one small-prize mechanism; Big Block can change or be removed independently.

requirements.title: Big Block Prize Mechanism
requirements.definition: Run the independently configurable large-prize block mechanism until the client removes it.
requirements.boundary_note: Big Block has its own parameter changes and eventual removal, so it must not be merged with Small Block.

requirements.title: Prize Ticket Lifecycle
requirements.definition: Issue ticket entries for qualifying mints, weight winning chances by ticket count, and expire or reset tickets after the applicable draw.
requirements.boundary_note: Ticket issuance and expiry form one lifecycle mechanism; recipient selection for no-referral mints is handled by a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Chainlink VRF Winner Selection
requirements.definition: Select prize winners and random reward recipients using verifiable Chainlink VRF randomness.
requirements.boundary_note: Randomness infrastructure can fail or be reconfigured independently from prize amounts and draw frequencies.

requirements.title: Prize Winner Claim Flow
requirements.definition: Expose a conditional claim action to eligible prize winners when a draw has completed.
requirements.boundary_note: Claiming is independently testable from winner selection and prize-trigger calculations.

requirements.title: Aave Prize-Pool Yield Integration
requirements.definition: Generate yield on prize-pool funds through Aave until the client removes that integration.
requirements.boundary_note: Aave yield is an optional financial mechanism that can be removed without changing the underlying prize draw.

requirements.title: Referral Code Identity and Validation
requirements.definition: Use each NFT's own mint number as its permanent referral code and accept only codes belonging to already minted NFTs.
requirements.boundary_note: Code identity and validation are one tightly coupled input rule; reward allocation after validation is handled separately.

requirements.title: Rewards for Mints Using a Referral Code
requirements.definition: For a successful mint using a valid referral code, award the selected existing NFT holder a $5 commission and the applicable prize ticket.
requirements.boundary_note: Commission and ticket are intentionally paired for a referred mint; no-code random allocation has a separate execution path.

requirements.title: Random Rewards for Mints Without a Referral Code
requirements.definition: When no valid referral code is used, randomly assign the $5 commission and prize ticket to an existing NFT holder, subject to the accepted first-mint exception.
requirements.boundary_note: This behavior has a distinct VRF/finalization and failure trajectory from normal referred-mint rewards; the first-mint exception is an attribute of this mechanism.

requirements.title: Mint Revenue Allocation
requirements.definition: Charge the defined mint price and split its proceeds among the founder, affiliate commission, and active prize pool according to the current client-approved allocation.
requirements.boundary_note: This Requirement owns the price and revenue split, not recipient selection for referral commissions or the mechanics of a particular payment currency.

requirements.title: USDC Wallet Mint Flow
requirements.definition: Allow a connected wallet to approve USDC spending and complete an NFT mint, with the mint occurring after approval and only successful transactions being treated as purchases.
requirements.boundary_note: USDC approval-to-mint behavior has a separate failure and recovery trajectory from ETH conversion and fiat card payment.

requirements.title: ETH Wallet Mint and Refund Flow
requirements.definition: Allow payment in ETH by converting only the amount needed for the fixed USDC mint price and returning any excess according to the client-approved refund behavior.
requirements.boundary_note: ETH swap pricing, exact-output conversion, and excess refund are attributes of one independently testable payment path.

requirements.title: Mint Payment Method Selection
requirements.definition: Clearly show supported mint payment methods and allow the buyer to select among currently enabled methods while disabling unavailable methods.
requirements.boundary_note: This covers method visibility and selection, not whether USDC, ETH, or Transak succeeds internally.

requirements.title: Transak Fiat On-Ramp
requirements.definition: Enable non-crypto buyers to purchase through Transak-supported card and mobile-payment methods, with the integration allowed to launch after the initial crypto-only release.
requirements.boundary_note: Provider choice, implementation deferral, and later resumption belong to one fiat-on-ramp lifecycle; Stripe and Coinbase Commerce are historical provider values rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Mint-Page Tipping
requirements.definition: Allow buyers to add preset or custom tips during minting, clearly disclose any separate follow-up transaction, and avoid meaningless self-tips from the founder wallet.
requirements.boundary_note: Tip amount selection, transfer execution, and its follow-up-transaction notice form one optional payment mechanism separate from the NFT purchase itself.

requirements.title: Mint Transaction Integrity
requirements.definition: Register and count a mint only when the on-chain mint succeeds and deliver the resulting NFT to the buyer.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the cross-cutting success-recording invariant; currency-specific approval, swap, and pricing behavior remains in separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Accurate Mint Success Feedback
requirements.definition: Show mint-success feedback only after the actual mint and required reward finalization have completed, using the correct token ID and context-specific referral message.
requirements.boundary_note: Success-feedback correctness has its own repeated failure/fix/verification trajectory and is separate from transaction execution.

requirements.title: Secondary-Sale Royalty Enforcement
requirements.definition: Use ERC-721C creator controls and marketplace restrictions to enforce the defined flat royalty on secondary sales.
requirements.boundary_note: Secondary royalty enforcement is independent of primary-mint revenue allocation and NFT content access.

requirements.title: NFT State on Secondary Transfer
requirements.definition: When an NFT is sold, transfer the book, mint-number referral identity, badges, and applicable active ticket state to the buyer while expired tickets remain expired.
requirements.boundary_note: Ownership-transfer semantics can evolve independently from royalty enforcement.

requirements.title: Dashboard NFT Inventory Accuracy
requirements.definition: Display the connected wallet's actual NFT holdings and correct total supply without false, missing, or duplicated NFTs.
requirements.boundary_note: NFT inventory visibility has a separate failure trajectory from reward totals and metadata attributes.

requirements.title: Reward and Leaderboard Statistics Accuracy
requirements.definition: Keep dashboard, leaderboard, homepage, and NFT-detail counts for tickets, referrals, commissions, earnings, and prize-pool values consistent with the authoritative reward state.
requirements.boundary_note: This Requirement concerns presentation and synchronization of reward state; the business rule that awards rewards is owned by referral Requirements.

requirements.title: NFT Metadata and Attribute Accuracy
requirements.definition: Expose resolvable NFT images and metadata whose referral, ticket, commission, badge, and earnings attributes match live authoritative state.
requirements.boundary_note: Metadata correctness is independently observable from whether an NFT appears in the dashboard inventory.

requirements.title: Badge Achievement Rules
requirements.definition: Award and display only badges actually earned from the defined referral milestones, including the First Referral badge.
requirements.boundary_note: Achievement eligibility and award accuracy are separate from badge icon, count, row layout, and mobile presentation.

requirements.title: Badge Set and Responsive Presentation
requirements.definition: Present the approved badge set with suitable icons and balanced responsive layout across dashboard screen sizes.
requirements.boundary_note: Visual badge selection and layout can change while the underlying milestone-award rules remain unchanged.

requirements.title: Removable IPFS Ebook Storage
requirements.definition: Store the ebook PDF through Pinata/IPFS in a way that preserves the client's ability to remove it if the project is discontinued.
requirements.boundary_note: Storage location and removability are independent from NFT ownership gating and reader navigation.

requirements.title: NFT-Holder Ebook Access Gating
requirements.definition: Use Lit Protocol to decrypt and display the ebook only after confirming that the user owns a valid Project Rebuild NFT.
requirements.boundary_note: Ownership authorization and decryption are separate from PDF page navigation and mobile wallet compatibility.

requirements.title: Desktop Ebook Reader Navigation
requirements.definition: Provide a readable PDF viewer with usable page-navigation controls for authenticated NFT holders on standard desktop browsers.
requirements.boundary_note: Reader controls have an independent failure/fix trajectory from ownership gating and mobile wallet signing.

requirements.title: Mobile Wallet Ebook Access
requirements.definition: Allow NFT holders using supported mobile wallet applications to complete the ownership signature and open the gated ebook reader.
requirements.boundary_note: Desktop access was verified while mobile access failed, demonstrating an independent compatibility trajectory.

requirements.title: Optional Offline PDF Download
requirements.definition: Offer NFT holders an optional PDF download link for offline reading in addition to the default read-only viewer.
requirements.boundary_note: Offline download can be independently retained, modified, or removed without changing the default browser reader.

requirements.title: Mint Email Certificate
requirements.definition: Provide an email certificate or confirmation after minting with NFT details and a link to access the ebook and dashboard.
requirements.boundary_note: Certificate content and availability are distinct from general email transport reliability.

requirements.title: Landing-Page Hero Content and Layout
requirements.definition: Present the approved Project Rebuild headline, book offer, referral mechanics, mint call-to-action, and supporting content in a clear responsive hero layout.
requirements.boundary_note: Hero wording and overall layout are grouped as one presentation unit; book-cover sizing and cropping have a separate visual trajectory.

requirements.title: Landing-Page Book Cover Presentation
requirements.definition: Display the ebook cover on the landing page at an aesthetically appropriate size without cropping or obscuring other controls.
requirements.boundary_note: Cover visibility and sizing changed and failed repeatedly independent of the surrounding hero copy.

requirements.title: Discord Community Server
requirements.definition: Provide a structured Project Rebuild Discord server with onboarding, announcements, community, feedback, support, bug-report, product, and voice channels.
requirements.boundary_note: The Discord server is an independently requested operational community deliverable, not merely generic project communication.

requirements.title: User Support Contact Form
requirements.definition: Provide a help or contact section with a form for user identity, contact details, subject, and support inquiry or feedback.
requirements.boundary_note: The form is an independently requested product support channel separate from the external Discord server.

requirements.title: Production Site Availability
requirements.definition: Keep the production Project Rebuild website reachable and functional after deployments.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a user-observable operational behavior supported by outage and recovery evidence, not a generic testing or deployment-process Requirement.

requirements.title: Wallet Security Warning Removal
requirements.definition: Submit and verify Project Rebuild with the relevant wallet-security service so users are not shown a false malicious-site warning.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a specific operational remediation deliverable, not a generic security-testing Requirement.

requirements.title: Contract Event Webhook
requirements.definition: Configure a Base Mainnet webhook that captures contract logs and routes mint, referral, ticket, and related events to the Project Rebuild backend.
requirements.boundary_note: The event-ingestion mechanism is an independently required operational behavior; secret values supplied during setup are not Requirement evidence.

requirements.title: Transak KYB UX Demo Video
requirements.definition: Deliver a video demonstrating how the Transak widget would be used on Project Rebuild for the provider's KYB review.
requirements.boundary_note: The video is a standalone provider-review deliverable, separate from implementing the actual fiat payment flow.

requirements.title: Super Admin Dashboard Proposal Document
requirements.definition: Prepare and share a document proposing a centralized administrative control panel for managing system operations.
requirements.boundary_note: Current evidence supports the proposal document as a deliverable, not implementation of the full Super Admin dashboard.

requirements.title: Transfer Mint Number One to Founder
requirements.definition: Transfer NFT mint and affiliate code number one to the client's specified founder wallet.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a one-off ownership obligation rather than a general NFT transfer rule.

unresolved_candidates.description: Prize payout descriptions alternate between direct payment language and a conditional manual claim button; Event extraction should preserve the chronology and verify whether the claim flow supersedes earlier automatic-payout wording.

The exact first-mint exception is not fully consistent: earlier implementation statements send the first commission to the founder, while later accepted totals imply the first mint awards neither a ticket nor referral commission.
The relationship between optional offline PDF download and strict NFT-holder gating is unclear; unrestricted downloading could conflict with the later encrypted-reader requirement.

The client describes a behind-the-scenes non-custodial wallet for fiat buyers, but the concrete Transak custody and wallet-creation behavior is not established clearly enough to create a separate wallet-provisioning Requirement without further evidence.

The contract setup guide and live demonstration appear primarily to be testing and handoff process; current evidence is insufficient to determine whether either should be retained as an independent deliverable Requirement.
